page_title: UNI 0-0 HAM | Union Berlin v Hamburger SV 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's it for today, Deniz Aytekin has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+12' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+12' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
90+8' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) brings down his opponent with a horror tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
90+8' Substitution. William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Giorgi Gocholeishvili walks off.
90+6' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+1' What was Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
90' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
89' Substitution. Ilyas Ansah did his best and is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
89' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
87' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
87' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play.
86' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.

85' Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Frederik Ronnow shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
84' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) replacing Miro Muheim.
81' It is time for a substitution. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is on for Derrick Kohn.
79' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
79' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
77' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) fires the ball against the bar direct from the corner kick. That was close!
77' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
76' Here is a change. Ransford Konigsdorffer is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).
76' Here comes a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) is brought on as a substitute for Rayan Philippe.
76' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Warmed Omari (Hamburger) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Guilherme Ramos.
74' Warmed Omari (Hamburger) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

74' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Chance! Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
72' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
71' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) has tested the patience of referee Deniz Aytekin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Rough tackle by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
68' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
66' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) makes a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.

63' A cross from the side line is well received by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) who doesn't hesitate to slam it goalwards. And his long-range effort wasn't poor at all. It attracted the keeper's attention as it missed the left post only by a whisker.
59' A substitution has been made. Janik Haberer is replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
59' Sebastian Bonig has decided to substitute Oliver Burke and he is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
55' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
54' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
53' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
52' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

52' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Frederik Ronnow has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hamburger SV are going to take it.
50' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.

50' What a sweet touch by Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
47' Dangerous play by Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin). Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
44' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
43' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
43' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
40' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) prepares to take a corner kick.
39' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
39' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hamburger SV.
38' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Hamburger SV will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
37' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
34' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
33' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is penalised for holding. Deniz Aytekin signals a set piece.
31' Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger).
31' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
30' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
30' It looks like Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) saw red with that tackle. Deniz Aytekin won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
25' Hamburger SV are seeing far more of the ball now.
20' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Deniz Aytekin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
18' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
15' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

10' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the left post. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Daniel Heuer Fernandes to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
10' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
9' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Union Berlin!
9' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

8' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
6' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Miro Muheim (Hamburger), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

6' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Deniz Aytekin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
4' The corner from Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is intercepted by the defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Hamburger SV will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin is the one to supervise the game today.
